vibe_rationale: Indonesia's leading contemporary art festival, rooted in Yogyakarta's artist community and carefully curated, but art-world led and more sponsor-heavy than SURPLUS.
fit_notes: A ten-week run gives long dwell time for a lounge, workshop or program partner, and the BRI bank partnership shows non-endemic brands are accepted. Wellness link is thin, and a June 2026 sponsor controversy is recorded, so check it first. Yogyakarta-based, so an Australian brand would need a local partner.
